meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 它会带你给某个私信频道接上第一个 NanoClaw agent：确认你在该频道的用户身份，创建或复用 agent 分组并完成消息接线，最后让 agent 走正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信来验证链路。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置且服务正在运行之后使用，比如你刚跑完 /setup 和 /add-<channel>、想让第一个 agent 接管私信时。

say.text: 帮我把第一个 agent 接到 Discord 上
say.note: 它会问选哪个频道并确认你的用户身份

say.text: 我的 Telegram 用户 ID 是 123456，显示名小明
say.note: 用于解析你在该频道的 DM 身份
它会直接查数据库和日志排查投递

howto.what_en: It walks you through standing up your first NanoClaw agent on a DM channel: resolves your channel identity, creates or reuses the agent group and wiring, then triggers a welcome DM through the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured and the service is running — for example right after /setup and an /add-<channel> skill, when you want the first agent wired to DMs.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent on Discord
say_en.note: It asks which channel and confirms your identity

say_en.text: My Telegram user ID is 123456, display name Alex
say_en.note: Used to resolve your DM identity
It checks the DB and logs for delivery
